study_type_evidence.type: none (secondary research: systematic review and meta-analysis; no primary experiments performed)
study_type_evidence.quote: Lastly, we also ensured that only peer-reviewed primary literature was included in this review
The citations captured by the systematic searches were imported into Covidence, a systematic review management software.
Only data available in the papers were extracted.

concentration_time_figure.note: No concentration-versus-time or percent-remaining-versus-time plot is presented. Fig 2 plots absolute mean differences in half-life (effect size), Fig 3 is a forest plot, Fig 4 a sensitivity analysis, Fig 5 a risk-of-bias summary, and Fig 1 a PRISMA flow diagram.

bioanalytical_method: not applicable (no primary bioanalysis performed by the authors)
bioanalytical_quote: The preferred methods for measuring the amount of peptide present in the bloodstream, and hence the half-lives, were enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) or some form of liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS).
notes: This paper is a PRISMA systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42020222579), not a primary study. No animals, humans, tissues, or cells were dosed or tested by these authors, so no study_types, in_vivo_species, or agents could be assigned from the body. All half-life values in the body (Table 3, Table 4, Fig 2) are secondary data transcribed from 16 other primary studies (e.g. Fukushima 2019 insulin-chondroitin/heparosan conjugates, Ichikawa 2018 GLP-1C-chondroitin/heparosan conjugates, which are the studies corresponding to the peplife2 rows for this PMID). Per the protocol's no-inference rule, these third-party values were not recorded as agents of this paper; the original publications should be extracted instead. The body does describe, in aggregate, the animal models used by the included studies ("varying strains of mice (BALB, ICR, and CD-1), rats (SD, Wistar), and monkeys"), but no species was dosed in this work. Eligibility was restricted to intravenously administered peptides smaller than insulin (5.8 kDa) composed of L-amino acids. The bioanalytical_quote above describes the methods used by the included primary studies, not by this review. Note also that the body reports a PMID/journal-agnostic full text; the header block PMID field was blank in the source file.
